purpose: Pressure-test autonomous acquisition of a verifier implementation independent from the already-verified BSON producer.
goal: Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json containing exactly four records with fields id and text: 1 alpha, 2 beta, 3 gamma, 4 delta. Encode those exact records as BSON and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_RECORDS.bson. Independently decode the BSON artifact using an implementation that is not provided by the BSON producer package, and verify the decoded records are exactly identical to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/BSON_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE.json in values, order, field names, and record count.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/state/ASTRA-RUNTIME-INDEPENDENT-CODEC-VERIFIER-BSON-001.json')
x=json.loads(p.read_text())
hist=x.get('history') or []
assert hist, x
trace=(hist[-1].get('result') or {}).get('trace') or []
inv=[t for t in trace if (t.get('plan') or {}).get('type')=='invoke_capability']
assert len(inv)>=2, inv
producer=(inv[0].get('plan') or {}).get('args',{}).get('capability_id')
verifier=(inv[-1].get('plan') or {}).get('args',{}).get('capability_id')
assert producer and verifier and producer!=verifier,(producer,verifier,inv)
print('INDEPENDENT_CODEC_VERIFIER_IMPLEMENTATION_VERIFIED')
PY
